text:
"Over a familiar block, the ramp crew brought up a point about tag checks, and we are really sorry" that your complaint concerns a delayed animal transfer, a missed onward journey, and the strain this placed on your travel plans and your companion's care.

We are treating this as a safety review matter, because any break in tag checks or handoff clarity can affect both schedule integrity and animal welfare. Your report indicates that the transfer chain did not stay as clear as it should have, and that is a serious operational fault. We understand how disruptive that is, especially when a traveler is already managing a companion animal and trying to keep the trip calm.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has sent the matter to the duty supervisor for review of the ramp record, the cabin log, and the transfer notes. We are also checking whether the welcome team and the handlers followed the expected humane workflow, because calm handling must be matched by precise tracking at every stage. If any step was missed, we will document it and correct it.

<<FACT F116>>

We also note your concern about the animal environment during boarding or in flight, and any sign of overheating must be handled at once. Cabin condition reports are being checked together with crew notes and any welfare observations so we can identify where control failed and whether the response was immediate and adequate.

<<FACT F111>>

Please keep all receipts, baggage tags, and service notes in one place while the review is active. If you send a short summary of the loss, the affected journey segment, and any visible welfare issue, we can keep the file aligned with the operational review and move it forward without delay. We cannot undo the disruption, but we can press for accountability and proper correction.

Aurelia Skyways will not treat this as routine, because shared responsibility means the traveler, the handlers, and the carrier all depend on clear execution. We are sorry for the distress and we will continue the review until the safety and service gaps are fully addressed.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
